response.overview: At a deserted carpark, three friends lie in wait for a man who thinks he made an appointment with a teenage girl. When the forty-something arrives, two boys beat him up. The third one freezes: he recognises his uncle. Next, panic strikes in this short drama. Will the man report them to the police? While the first two do not want to take any risk and decide to pay the man a home visit, the desperate third one tries to prevent an impending catastrophe.
response.title: Jagers
